name: Jarvis
author: Gustavo von Atzingen
description: Voice assistant for Omarchy: wake word, natural conversation with barge-in, answers from your own Codex or Claude subscription, machine access gated by per-command consent by default, a live conversation window and dictation into any app. Every option is customizable from a settings screen: speech recognition (Whisper, Nemotron or OpenAI) and vocabulary, agent and model, computer access, voice, dictation. Bar widget with status, dictation controls and settings.

barWidget.description: Voice assistant status (on / paused / off / recording) with a tooltip on hover and a click-to-open panel in cards: voice guide, dictation (speech-to-text) start/stop, keybindings, on/off, pause, logs, settings.
